claim_en: THE GUILT-OFFERING'S ONE LAW: Not on a bamah; all guilt-offerings' blood goes BELOW the red line — the leper's included, against its own as-the-sin-offering clause (Lev 14:13). Intermixed bloods (guilt with peace, both below) are sprinkled for either; animals interchanged ALIVE are not — they graze until blemished, are sold, and a higher-priced animal is brought as each type, the difference from his pocket (R. Shimon's alternative recorded).

THE OPEN SLAUGHTER CLASS: 'Shall THEY slaughter' — slaughter is valid from proselytes, women, and servants; the slaughter verb itself defined as DRAWING-FORTH from the drawn-gold ink of I Kings 10:16; R. Eliezer derives the communal burnt-offering's north here.

THE WORD-POSITION ARGUMENT: The sin-offering and the Pesach carry their restrictive 'it' AT THE SLAUGHTER clause; the guilt-offering's 'it' sits AFTER the smoking — and even unsmoked portions leave it kasher: so a guilt-offering slaughtered not-for-its-sake STAYS FIT (R. Eliezer's contrary analogy recorded and answered), and 'it' teaches instead that IT is sacrificed but its EXCHANGE is not. Valid without hand-laying; fire-consigned.

THE BLEMISH LADDER CLOSES: 'Every male' here adds the last uncovered case — the priest BORN blemished shares; eating, apportionment, and permanent blemishes carried at their own seats; communal peace-offerings eaten by the male priests; the thank-offering and the Nazirite ram excluded.

AS THE ONE, SO THE OTHER: As the sin-offering, the guilt-offering comes from mundane money, by day, with the right hand; 'one law' adds HAND-LAYING to both. The atoning priest's trio of exclusions (day-immersed, atonement-lacking, mourner) bars flesh AND hide alike. Rebbi's principle: THE HIDE FOLLOWS THE FLESH — burnt offerings' hides burn with them, eaten offerings' hides go with the meat, and only the burnt-offering needed its own verse: flesh to the altar, hide to the priests — even from an olah slaughtered not-for-its-sake; higher-order hides only.

THE SHARING LATTICE: 'To the priest who offers it' against 'to all the sons of Aaron' resolves to the PRIESTLY HOUSEHOLD of the day. NO APPORTIONMENT TRADES: meal-offerings are never traded against flesh, birds against meal, meal against meal, pan against griddle, nor same against same — every priest shares in every kind, higher and lower order alike; and the share rides ADULT STANDING: the blemished adult shares, the minor does not even unblemished.

source: Sifra, Tzav, Section 5 1-2, 5 8, Chapter 9 1, Section 2 4, Chapter 3 3, 3 6; Mishnah Zevachim 5:5, 8:11, 10:2, 10:5; Mishnah Menachot 6:1; Mishnah Tamid 4:3
claim_en: ONE LAW, AND THE RAM'S LIST IS THE LAMB'S. The guilt offering's law compiled: north and two-that-are-four by call, the fat list of 7:3-4 matching Lev 3:9-10's lamb part for part, every male priest in a holy place, 'one law' = hand-laying, day, right hand, the atoning priest; the meal offering's law beside it with the fistful and remainder by call. Filed F-219, auto-seated (the dependency-debt sitting).
